title: Undertow and Silence
author: Jonah Ishikawa
blurb: Vesper Nakamura, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
